items.title: Christian McCaffrey: Reenters Sunday's game
items.text:
McCaffrey (thigh) returned to Sunday's contest in Atlanta, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Kenny Gainwell: Sustains hip injury, iffy to return
items.text:
Gainwell exited Sunday's game against the Panthers in the third quarter with a hip injury and is questionable to return, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jonah Coleman: Returning to action in Week 7
items.text:
Coleman (ankle) is listed as active Sunday at Arizona, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Alvin Kamara: Heavy workload as pass catcher Sunday
items.text:
Kamara carried the ball six times for five yards and caught all seven of his targets for 57 yards in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyrone Tracy: Exits Sunday with hamstring issue
items.text:
Tracy left Sunday's game at Houston due to a hamstring injury, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.
